description: This file defines the class 'hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security' which provides an interface for WiFi endpoint security parameters, including security modes, WEP keys, PSK, and passphrases, with methods to retrieve these parameters. It also includes licensing information and documentation comments.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security
classes.description: Class providing access to WiFi endpoint security parameters and related methods.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security_ModeEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves the security mode enabled for the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security_WEPKey
methods.description: Retrieves the WEP key as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security_PreSharedKey
methods.description: Retrieves the PreSharedKey (PSK) as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security_KeyPassphrase
methods.description: Retrieves the passphrase used to generate the PreSharedKey.
